changes.commit: **Mac**: Fix error causes by unsupported 8-bit single channel surface. (Surface Extrude, Markov, Path from Mask, RM to Voxel, RM to Mesh)
- Linux build now comes Linux libraries and downloader. - Due to license, FFmpeg will now not be included in the software. A popup will appear with download link to download the required binary.
**Path from Mask**: Fix error with surface larger than 256x256px.
**Path Fill / Map / Revolve / SDF**: Add transform, path range properties.
